caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded ceramic jar with a wide shoulder and a slightly narrower neck and rim. The jar is predominantly a uniform brown color, with a slightly lighter, glossy glaze effect indicating shine and texture. Drips of a lighter brown or tan glaze run down from the top on the right side, creating irregular vertical lines. There are two small rounded handles attached to the upper part of the jar, positioned close to the neck. The background is plain and off-white, with a faint rectangular border framing the jar. The artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," is written in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
